parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two test methods share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.7778), they are intentionally distinct behavioral assertions: one verifies that a stop action transitions state to idle, the other verifies that `isPlaying` becomes false after a stop. Merging or extracting them would obscure the distinct failure signals each test is designed to surface, which is the canonical reason test fixtures are exempted from deduplication.
